quests.title: A Flock for Hirta
quests.summary: Dot wants a flock of Loaghtan lambs, bred from three different pairings, like the sheep of Hirta: a flock is not a family.

steps.text: Ask Dr Keir at the Roslin Institute, in Edinburgh, why a flock needs founders.
Breed four Loaghtan lambs from at least three pairings, no more than two counted from one, and show Dot.

quests.reward: The breed society's grant, two Cream Teas and standing in Scotland.

quests.title: The Kerry Herd
quests.summary: Dot's cousin Bríd needs a herd for her Kerry yard that is not one family: four young Moolets from unrelated pairings.

steps.text: Ask Dr Keir how to tell cousins from strangers in a pedigree.
Breed four young Moolets from at least two pairings that share no parent, and show Dot.

quests.reward: The breed society's grant, two Cream Teas and standing in Ireland.

quests.title: Wildcats, Pure and Plenty
quests.summary: Dr Keir wants three young Wildkits from pure pairs, with no hybrid blood in the pedigree, for the sake of the Scottish wildcat.

steps.text: Hear from Dr Keir why interbreeding is the wildcat's trouble.
Breed three young Wildkits from pure Wildkit pairs and show Dr Keir.

quests.reward: The breed society's grant, two Cream Teas and standing in Scotland.
